Let \(t=\frac ba\). From \(a\ge b\ge c\) and \(c=-a-b\), we get \(a\ge b\ge -a-b\), so
\[
-\frac12 \le t \le 1.
\]
Also,
\[
b^2-4ac=(b+2a)^2,
\]
so
\[
|x_1^2-x_2^2|=\frac{|b|\sqrt{(b+2a)^2}}{a^2}
=|t|(t+2).
\]
For \(t\in[-1/2,1]\), the minimum of \(|t|(t+2)\) is \(0\), and the maximum is \(3\). Therefore the sum is
\[
0+3=\boxed{3}.
\]
